# Aqua Hub UI — Roblox client executor library

> Aqua Hub is a single-file Luau UI library for Roblox client executor scripts, branded Aqua Hub by von63rd with a blue Aqua appearance layer: a window with a sidebar of tabs, sub tabs, two-column collapsible groupboxes and native controls and readouts (toggles, sliders, dropdowns, statuses, tables and more), plus configs, live themes, coloured text, window-wide search and a draggable Dynamic Island minimize. This file is a guide for language models writing scripts with it. Follow it exactly; the README covers setup; the readable source defines every option.

Load it once, build the window, add tabs, put groupboxes on tabs (or sub tabs), and put elements in groupboxes. Every element with a `Flag` is saved by configs. Individual element handles expose the applicable `Set` / `Get` methods, plus common visibility, disabled, dependency, tooltip, and destroy methods. Collection constructors return collections; do not assume every constructor has the same value methods.

## Files

Repository: [voidhub9-dotcom/Aqua](https://github.com/voidhub9-dotcom/Aqua)

- [Readme.MD](Readme.MD): the branded setup guide, common examples, capability notes and license.
- [Example.lua](Example.lua): the complete library embedded with a standalone Aqua Hub showcase of selected native controls and the appearance editor. It does not demonstrate every element; use the API tables below and the readable source for less common options.
- [Source.lua](Source.lua): the complete readable library and appearance extension; returns `Library`. This is what scripts `loadstring`. It is not the original upstream minified build.

## Loading

This is NOT a Roblox Studio project. Do not instruct users to create ModuleScripts or LocalScripts, install into ReplicatedStorage, or use `require(ReplicatedStorage.AquaHub)`. Use the original executor loading pattern below. HTTP, file, clipboard, and custom-asset features depend on executor capabilities.

```lua
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/voidhub9-dotcom/Aqua/main/Source.lua"))()
```

Optional, before native `CreateWindow`: `Library:LoadFont({ Name = "ValleySans" })`, `Library:SetDefaultTheme("Nebula")`, `Library:PreloadIcons()`. With `CreateAquaHubWindow`, pass `Theme = "Nebula"` in the options to select that starting preset instead of the wrapper default.

## Skeleton to start from

```lua
local Window = Library:CreateAquaHubWindow({
    Name = "Aqua Hub",                       -- title, also names the ScreenGui
    LoadingSubtitle = "by von63rd",
    ToggleUIKeybind = "RightControl",      -- hides and shows the window
    ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = true, FolderName = "MyHub" },
    Home = { Discord = "dsc.gg/myhub" },   -- built-in first tab; false removes it
})

local Main = Window:CreateTab({ Name = "Main", Icon = "swords" })     -- Icon: any lucide name
local Farm = Main:CreateGroupbox({ Name = "Farming", Side = "Left" })  -- or Main:AddLeftGroupbox("Farming", "sprout")
local Info = Main:CreateGroupbox({ Name = "Info", Side = "Right" })

local AutoFarm = Farm:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Auto Farm",
    Flag = "AutoFarm",                     -- unique; makes it saveable and reachable as Window.Flags.AutoFarm
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(On)
        -- runs on every change, and once at creation when CurrentValue is true
    end,
})

Farm:CreateSlider({ Name = "Range", Range = { 5, 50 }, Increment = 1, CurrentValue = 20, Suffix = " studs", Flag = "Range", Callback = function(V) end })
Farm:CreateDropdown({ Name = "Mobs", Options = { "Bandit", "Wolf" }, MultipleOptions = true, Flag = "Mobs", Callback = function(List) end })

Info:CreateStatus({ Name = "State", Style = "Row", Pin = true, Update = function()
    return AutoFarm.Value and "<Success>Farming</Success>" or "<Muted>Idle</Muted>"
end })

local Settings = Window:CreateTab({ Name = "Settings", Icon = "settings" })
Settings:CreateConfigManager({ Side = "Left" })
Settings:CreateThemeManager({ Side = "Right" })

Window:LoadAutoload()                      -- apply the player's autoload config, if any
```

## Rules that prevent most mistakes

- Constructors exist with and without the `Create` prefix: `Tab:CreateToggle` and `Tab:Toggle` are the same. Pick one style per script.
- Options are a single table. Legacy names are accepted (`Title` for `Name`, `Description` for `Desc`, `CurrentValue` / `Default` / `Value` for the start value, `MultipleOptions` / `Multi`), but prefer the names in this file.
- Once a tab has sub tabs (`Tab:CreateSubTab({ Name = "Page" })`), add groupboxes and elements to the sub tabs, not the tab.
- Elements added straight to a tab are full-width cards; elements in a groupbox are compact rows. Groupboxes are the normal choice.
- `Flag` strings must be unique within a window. Each window has `Window.Flags`; configs, dependencies, resets and island counts use that window only. `Library.Flags` is a latest-registered compatibility map, so prefer `Window.Flags` when creating several windows. Toggles, sliders, steppers, dropdowns, order lists, inputs, keybinds and colour pickers take flags. Labels, buttons and statuses are not saveable value controls. Editable tables may also use `Flag` when configured with typed columns and editing options.
- Flagged toggles that are on count as "running" on the minimized island. Don't flag a toggle that is only a setting if that would mislead; a setting is still fine to flag.
- `Set(value, true)` skips the callback. Use it when syncing UI from code.
- `Update` functions may yield (`InvokeServer`, `task.wait`); they run on their own thread. Element callbacks run inline and errors are caught and warned, so keep them quick and wrap long loops in `task.spawn`. Library calls made from a thread that yielded in an engine call are made safe automatically.
- `Update` functions on labels and statuses run every `UpdateRate` seconds (default 1). Status lists only refresh while visible.
- `Window:LoadAutoload()` may run before every element exists: values for flags not created yet are held and applied when the element appears.
- Never build your own config, theme or minimize UI. Use `CreateConfigManager`, `CreateThemeManager` and the built-in island.
- Icons: a lucide name (`"zap"`, `"lucide:zap"`), an asset id number or `"rbxassetid://…"`, or `{ Image, RectOffset, RectSize, Tint }`.
- `Library.Touch` is true on touch-only devices. Layout already adapts; only read it for game logic.

## Elements

Every element takes `Name`, `Desc` (a muted hint under the name), `Tooltip` (a string or `{ Title, Text, Icon }`) `Visible`, `Disabled`, and `DependsOn` (`"Flag"`, `{ Flag, Value, Not }`, a list of rules, or a function) with `DependsMode = "Hide"` (default) or `"Disable"`. Prefer `DependsOn` over toggling visibility in callbacks.

| Constructor | Key options | Handle |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Button` | `Icon`, `Style = "Primary"`, `Confirm` (true or text: click twice), `ConfirmTimeout`, `HoldToConfirm` (true or seconds), `Callback()` | `SetText(text)`, `Disarm()` |
| `ButtonRow` | list of `{ Name, Callback, Style }` (`"Primary"` / `"Danger"`) | `SetText(i, text)`, `.Buttons` |
| `Toggle` | `CurrentValue`, `Flag`, `Callback(bool)` | `.Value`, `Set`, `Get` |
| `Slider` | `Range = { min, max }`, `Increment`, `Suffix`, `CurrentValue`, `Flag`, `Callback(n)`, `OnRelease(n)` | `.Value`, `.Dragging`, `Set`, `Get` |
| `Stepper` | `Range`, `Increment`, `Suffix`, `CurrentValue`, `Flag`, `Callback(n)` | `.Value`, `Set`, `Get` |
| `Dropdown` | `Options`, `CurrentOption`, `MultipleOptions`, `AllowNone`, `Searchable`, `MaxRows`, `NoneText`, `Stacked`, `Flag`, `Callback(value or list)` | `Set`, `Get`, `SetOptions(options, { KeepSelection = true, Silent = false })`, `GetOptions`, `Refresh(options, keepSelection?, skipCallback?)`, `SetOpen`, `.Open` |
| `OrderList` | `Items`, `MaxRows`, `Numbered`, `Arrows`, `Flag`, `Callback(order)` | `.Value`, `Set(order)`, `Refresh(items)`, `Get` |
| `Input` | `PlaceholderText`, `CurrentValue`, `Numeric`, `Icon`, `Flag`, `Callback(textOrNumber, enterPressed)` | `Set`, `Get` |
| `Keybind` | `CurrentKeybind` (`"F"` or `Enum.KeyCode.F`), `Flag`, `Callback(key)`, `OnChanged(key)` | `.Value`, `.Listening`, `Set`, `Get` |
| `ColorPicker` | `Color`, `Flag`, `Callback(Color3)` | `.Value`, `Set`, `Get`, `SetOpen` |
| `Label` | `Text` (or a bare string), `Color`, `Update`, `UpdateRate` | `Set`, `Get`, `SetColor` |
| `Paragraph` | `Title`, `Content` | `Set(text)` |
| `Section` | a string | `Set(text)` |
| `Divider` | `Text` (optional caption) | — |
| `Status` | `Value`, `Style` (`Plain`, `Row`, `Badge`, `Dot`, `Bar`, `Stat`), `Tone`, `Color`, `Max`, `Prefix`, `Suffix`, `Pin`, `Update`, `UpdateRate` | `Set(value, max?)`, `Get`, `SetTone`, `SetColor`, `SetName` |
| `Statuses` | `(entries, shared)`: names or option tables | table of status handles by name |
| `StatusList` | `Rows`, `MaxRows`, `EmptyText`, `Update` returning rows | `Set(rows)`, `Get`, `Clear`, `SetName` |
| `Progress` | `CurrentValue` 0..1, `Color`, `TextColor`, `Format(fraction)` | `Set`, `Get`, `SetColor`, `SetTextColor` |
| `Table` | `Columns` (names or `{ Name, Key, Width, Align, Format, Color, Sortable }`), `Rows`, `Rank`, `SortBy`, `MaxRows`, `Search` (built-in search box, default on), `Highlight(row)`, `Callback(row, i)`. Editable: give columns a `Type` (`Text`, `Number`, `Toggle`, `Dropdown` with `Options`, `Searchable`, `SearchAfter`, `MaxRows`), plus `OnChanged(rows)`, `NewRow`, `AllowAdd`, `AllowRemove`, `Flag` | `SetRows`, `AddRow`, `UpdateRow`, `RemoveRow`, `Clear`, `Sort`, `SetColumns`, `SetSearch(text)`, `Get` |
| `Log` (also `Feed`) | `MaxEntries` (default 100), `MaxRows` (lines shown), `Timestamps`, `TimeFormat`, `EmptyText` | `Push(text, color?)`, `Clear`, `Get`, `SetMaxEntries`, `SetTitle` |
| `Image` | `Image` (asset id, link, file, preset or `"Avatar"`), `Height`, `Caption`, `ScaleType` | `SetImage`, `SetCaption`, `SetTitle` |

Status list rows are strings (one muted wrapped line) or `{ Text, Value, Tone }`. Table rows are value lists in column order or tables keyed by column `Key`; add `Highlight = true` to mark a row and `Colors = { [key or index] = color }` to colour single cells.

## Coloured text

Status keys and values, status list rows, table cells, progress text, labels and paragraphs are rich text.

- Theme tags follow the theme: `"<Success>Online</Success>"`, `"<Warning>3 left</Warning>"`, `"<Error>Down</Error>"`, `"<Accent>…</Accent>"`, `"<Muted>…</Muted>"`. Every theme key works as a tag.
- `Library.Colorize(text, color)` builds it: a theme key gives a theme tag, a `Color3` or `"#rrggbb"` gives a fixed `<font color>`.
- Plain Roblox rich text (`<b>`, `<i>`, `<font color="#ff5a5a">`) also works.
- Whole-value colours accept a theme key string, `Color3`, `"#rrggbb"` or `{ r, g, b }`: status `Color` / `Tone`, status list `Tone` / `Color`, table column `Color` (or a function of `value, row`), progress `Color` / `TextColor`, label `Color`.
- Escape `<`, `>` and `&` in user-provided text you put into these elements.

Theme keys: `Background`, `Surface`, `Surface2`, `Surface3`, `Stroke`, `StrokeHover`, `Accent`, `AccentDark`, `Text`, `Muted`, `Success`, `Warning`, `Error`.

## Window

Useful options: `Size` (UDim2), `MinSize` / `MaxSize` (Vector2), `Icon`, `Theme`, `UIScale` (0.6 to 1.5), `AdaptiveSize` (default true: scale with screen resolution), `Density` (`"Compact"`, `"Default"`, `"Comfortable"`), `Backdrop` (`{ Weather = "Snow" }` or false), `Search`, `Profile`, `Loading`, `Disclaimer`, `ToggleButton`, `IslandDraggable` (default true).

Useful methods: `Notify({ Title, Content, Type = "Success", Duration })`, `Confirm({ Title, Content, ConfirmText, Callback })`, `Dialog({ Buttons = { … } })`, `Toggle(open?)`, `Minimize()`, `Restore()`, `SelectTab(tab)`, `SetUIScale(n)`, `SetAdaptiveSize(bool)`, `SetTheme` (on `Library`), `SaveConfig` / `LoadConfig` / `ListConfigs`, `ResetIslandPosition()`, `Destroy()`.

Minimizing folds the window into a Dynamic Island at the top of the screen. Players can drag it anywhere; `Pin = true` statuses show on it with their colours.

## Theme

- `Library:SetTheme("Aqua")` or `Library:SetTheme({ Accent = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248) })`; every colour cross-fades live.
- Presets: Aqua (fresh library and enhanced factory default), Aqua Ice, Aqua Mono, Midnight, Nebula, Synthwave, Sakura, Velvet, Rose, Crimson, Sunset, Amber, Gold, Cyber, Toxic, Matcha, Emerald, Aurora, Ocean, Frost, Abyss, Mono, Halloween, Haunted, Christmas, Valentine, Lunar, Tropical, Dracula, Coffee.
- `Tab:CreateThemeManager({ Side = "Right" })` gives players presets, weather, dim, transparency, drag skeleton, adaptive size, UI scale, density, background image and colour pickers. All of it is saved in configs under the hidden `__Theme` flag.
- Read colours from `Library.Theme.Accent` and so on; don't cache them across theme changes.

## Optional

- Optional Home supports a profile card, live stats, game/executor cards, feature lists and changelog pages; see the readable source for its options.
- [README: Flags and configuration](Readme.MD#flags-and-configuration): persistence, flag scope, executor file APIs, and configuration caveats.
- Icons use Lucide names or supported custom assets. Optional custom fonts need file and custom-asset APIs; see `Library:LoadFont` in the source.

## Aqua Hub factories and defaults

- `Library:CreateAquaHubWindow(options)` calls native `CreateWindow` and attaches appearance methods. Defaults: title `Aqua Hub`, subtitle `by von63rd`, `DefaultTheme = "Aqua"` when no theme is supplied, and `ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false, FolderName = "AquaHub" }` when absent. An explicit `Title` is respected as well as `Name`.
- Legacy `CreateKawiXDWindow` and `CreateNullFireWindow` are aliases of the new factory. `Library.AquaHub` (also exposed through legacy metadata aliases) reports `Name = "Aqua Hub"`, `Author = "von63rd"`, `Version = "1.1.0"`, `AppearanceVersion = 1`.
- Native `Library:CreateWindow(options)` is still available. It defaults to title `Aqua Hub`, subtitle `by von63rd`, config folder `AquaHub`, and a fresh blue `Aqua` palette, but does not attach the appearance methods. Prior library themes and a saved player default can affect its palette. The enhanced factory explicitly requests `Aqua` unless overridden; saved player defaults still take precedence.
- **The source does not enforce `ConfigurationSaving.Enabled`: `Enabled = false` does not disable native file operations, asset caching or hidden size flags.** Use `FolderName`, flags, `CreateConfigManager` and explicit `LoadAutoload` for native persistence. Appearance export is explicit and distinct from native config persistence.
- The default in-game hub logo is `rbxassetid://89294804014911` (`Library.Assets.Logo`). It is not recolored by the theme. The supplied Discord-server PNG is displayed directly in the README via a GitHub release asset, without adding a fifth root file.

## Aqua appearance extension

Native presets remain available. The default `Aqua` preset uses cyan-blue #38BDF8 on navy #07111F. Additional presets: `Aqua Ice` and `Aqua Mono`. Historical preset names are privately mapped to these names rather than shown as old brands in theme menus.

`Library:RegisterTheme(name, palette) -> true | false, error`: a nonblank name of at most 64 characters and at least one native palette key. Values are `Color3` or six-digit hex strings (optional `#`); omitted keys inherit the current theme. Use `Library:SetTheme(name)` to apply it.

On a window from `CreateAquaHubWindow`:

- `Window:SetBackgroundStyle(options) -> true | false, error`: `{ Source, Transparency, Tint, ScaleType, TileSize, Dim }`. Source is a preset, accessible asset ID, supported URL/file, or `"None"`; `false`/empty also clears. `Transparency` and `Dim` are 0..1; `Tint` is Color3/hex; `ScaleType` is `"Crop"`, `"Fit"`, `"Tile"`, or `"Stretch"`; `TileSize = { X, Y }` with dimensions 1..4096. Partial updates preserve omitted fields. Invalid/unresolved sources preserve the previous background. Actual asset display still depends on permissions and image availability.
- `Window:GetBackgroundStyle()` returns a detached normalized table, including hex `Tint`.
- Background presets: `Deep Violet`, `Blood Red`, `Cyanic`, `Amber Glow`, `Bloomings`, `Lavender Pink` (separate from color themes).
- `Window:GetAppearance()` returns a detached JSON-safe snapshot: `{ Version = 1, Theme = { nativeKey = "#RRGGBB", ... }, Background = { ... }, UIScale, AdaptiveSize, Density, CornerRadius }`.
- `Window:ExportAppearance() -> json | nil, error`.
- `Window:ApplyAppearance(tableOrJSON) -> true | false, error`: validates supplied fields before applying them, resolves the fallible background before changing theme/layout, accepts partial profiles, supports version 1, rejects JSON over 131072 bytes. `UIScale` 0.6..1.5; `AdaptiveSize` boolean; `Density` Compact/Default/Comfortable; `CornerRadius` 0..20.
- `Window:CreateAppearanceTab({ Name = "Appearance", Icon = "palette" })` or `Library:CreateAppearanceTab(Window, options)` adds the native theme manager, background editor and JSON import/export. Requires the enhanced factory.

Profiles do not automatically save to disk or include control flags/gameplay state. Use native configs separately. Native theme/config storage does not cover every extra background-style field; use appearance export for the complete look. Themes, density and corner radius are library-wide; backgrounds are per-window. Adaptive size is viewport-based, not physical DPI detection. Do not promise an upload picker or universal URL/file image support.

## Attribution and distribution

The native API is preserved; Aqua Hub by von63rd adds blue branding and the appearance extension. Exactly four root files are distributed: `Source.lua`, `Example.lua`, `Readme.MD`, `llms.txt`. Do not reference a bundled docs site, source tree, build scripts, or extra asset folders. See Readme.MD for attribution and the existing license text. Native icons, fonts, images and some Home features can access external resources when used.

## Extended UI API: source-exact rules

Use the readable source for full signatures, option aliases and rare corner cases; the notes below summarize the supported handles. Do not invent getters/setters from symmetry.

### Library and window details

- `Library:Window(options)` aliases `CreateWindow`. Library `Notify`, `Confirm`, and `Dialog` forward to the newest window, returning nil if none exists. `Library:Destroy()` / `Unload()` destroys all windows; window destruction affects one.
- `Library:SetDensity(mode)` accepts Compact/Default/Comfortable case-insensitively, invalid → Default, and returns the mode. There is **no** `Library:GetDensity`; use `Window:GetDensity`. `Library:SetCornerRadius(pixels, instant?)` returns the rounded/clamped 0..20 integer.
- `Window:SelectTab(tab)` needs the tab object, **not** a name/index. `Tab:SelectSubTab(sub, instant?)` additionally resolves a name or 1-based index. `Window:SetKeybind` stores the supplied value directly: pass Enum.KeyCode, not a string (constructor strings are normalized).
- `Window:SetSidebarWidth(value)` floors/clamps to 150..300 px with available-space limits; `SetSize(Vector2, instant?)`, `GetSize`, `SetKeepOnScreen`, `SetMinimized`, `SetIslandDraggable`, and `ResetIslandPosition` are public.
- `SetDragStyle` returns Outline/Brackets/Ghost/Frame/Off; invalid → Outline. `SetDragSkeleton(false)` selects Off. `SetIslandStyle` returns Show on Hover/Always Show; invalid → Show on Hover.
- `SetToggleButton`, `SetToggleButtonPlatform` (Mobile/Both), `SetToggleButtonIcon`, `SetHideName`, `SetHideAvatar`, `SetTransparent`, `ShowFeatures`, `CopyToClipboard(text,label?)`, `Rejoin`, `ServerHop`, and `JoinLowestServer` are native window methods. Clipboard/teleport require executor/network capabilities.
- `Window:Notify(opts)` returns a handle with `Dismiss()`. `Dialog`/`Confirm` return a dialog handle with `Close()`. Do not assume these are value controls.
- `SetBackdrop(enabled)` and `SetDim(enabled)` are boolean switches, not option tables or amounts. `SetBackdropTint(n)` clamps 0..1. `SetWeatherMode` accepts UI/Window/Inside (case-insensitive) for UI, otherwise Screen. Weather canonical values are Rain/Snow/Ember/Sakura/Fireflies/Matrix with documented aliases; `None`/other unrecognized names stop particles. `SetWeatherDensity` clamps 0..3 and `SetWeatherSpeed` clamps 0.1..3.
- `Window:SetIgnoreFlags(array)` accumulates ignored names. `SetLoadingOrder(arrayOrNil)` overrides/restores type ordering; default Library.LoadingOrder is Dropdown, Slider, Stepper, Input, ColorPicker, Keybind, Toggle. Config setters run on deferred threads. `OnConfigChanged(fn)` returns a disconnect function.
- Config APIs include ConfigExists, SaveConfig, LoadConfig, DeleteConfig, RenameConfig, ListConfigs, ResetConfig, ClearWorkspace, ExportConfig, DecodeConfig, ImportConfig, Get/SetAutoloadMode, Get/SetAutoload, Get/SetMinimizeOnStart, LoadAutoload. `ClearWorkspace` deletes the config folder. `LoadAutoload` is guarded against running twice. `ExportConfig` emits JSON; `DecodeConfig` also accepts legacy prefixed base64. `ImportConfig(code,saveAs?,force?)` returns true,nil,savedName or false,error; without saveAs it applies only.
- `Window:SaveTheme`, `LoadTheme`, `DeleteTheme`, `ListThemes`, `SetDefaultTheme`, `GetDefaultTheme`, `SetBackground`, `GetBackground`, `SetBackgroundTransparency`, and `ListBackgrounds` remain native. The window default-theme setter takes a name; the library setter also accepts a palette table/nil.

### Containers and compatibility

Groupboxes expose PopOut, Dock, IsPoppedOut, SetCollapsed, Collapse, Expand, IsCollapsed, SetTitle, SetVisible, IsVisible, Destroy. Tabboxes expose AddTab/CreateTab, SelectTab(page object), SetTitle, IsVisible, SetVisible, Destroy; pages expose Select, Expand, Collapse (compatibility no-op), IsCollapsed, SetTitle, Destroy. `Tab:SetBadge` is a removed-feature no-op with one warning; `GetBadge` returns nil. Do not build badges assuming these work. `Tab:CreateMinimizeOnStart` returns the built-in setting control.

### Handle and value details

- Shared finished-element methods include IsDisabled and GetTooltip as well as SetDisabled, SetTooltip, SetDependsOn, SetVisible, IsVisible, Destroy. Collections/managers are not identical element handles. SetTooltip(nil/false) clears; SetDependsOn(nil) removes the dependency.
- Toggle Set requires literal true; truthy strings/numbers are false. Slider/Stepper normalize Increment→Step, Range→Min/Max. Label and polling status handles expose SetUpdateRate (Label only when constructed with Update). Divider has Set for its caption.
- Numeric Input Get/callbacks return number|nil, not text; supported numeric separators and magnitude suffixes are parsed. Invalid numeric edits restore the prior valid text. Programmatic Set invokes callback unless silent. Keybind Get returns Enum.KeyCode|nil and Set invokes OnChanged, not the action Callback.
- Dropdown Refresh(options,keepSelection?,silent?) defaults keepSelection=false; SetOptions defaults it true and accepts settings table/boolean. GetOptions returns a copy. Unavailable selections can be remembered for configs. OrderList Refresh(items,keepOrder?,silent?) preserves order by default and remembers unavailable values.
- ColorPicker Set requires Color3, and SetOpen/.Open exist. Progress values are fractions 0..1; SetColor/SetTextColor exist. Section text is uppercased. Paragraph Set changes the body, not the title.
- Image exposes SetImage/Set (true or false,error), Get (last source), SetCaption, SetScaleType, SetColor (Color3 or white), SetTitle. URL/file resolution is executor-dependent.
- Table exposes SetColumns, SetRows/Set, GetRows/Get (**live rows**, not a detached copy), AddRow (new row count), UpdateRow/RemoveRow (boolean), Clear, Sort, SetTitle, SetMaxRows, NewRow (row), SetSearch. Editable tables support OnChanged and Flag. Log/Feed exposes Push/Add/Log (returns entry), Clear, Get (detached entries oldest-first), SetTitle, SetMaxEntries.
- Status exposes Set, Get, SetTone, SetColor, SetName, SetUpdateRate, SetWrap. Statuses returns handles keyed by name. StatusList exposes Set/Get(copy), Clear, SetName, SetUpdateRate and refreshes only while shown.
- ConfigManager returns a manager with Refresh/Create/Save/Load/Delete/Rename/Reset/SetAutoload/ClearAutoload/ToggleAutoload/SetAutoloadMode/Export/Import; UI mutators notify instead of returning the window success/error pair. ThemeManager returns Refresh/Create/Save/Load/Delete/ToggleDefault. Native theme manager hidden __Theme Get/Set covers native look fields but not every appearance extension field.
- Appearance ApplyAppearance accepts omitted Version for a partial profile; an explicit Version must be 1. SetBackgroundStyle returns true or false,error, **not** a style table; call GetBackgroundStyle for normalized state.

### Documentation visuals

The README displays the supplied original logo from a GitHub release asset. No fifth repository file or bundled docs site is required. Compilation and targeted mock regressions are not proof of an in-game runtime test.
